svg.title: Auction House / forecourt gate study
svg.desc: Street-level view through the round-arched Forecourt Gate into the quiet walled close: colonnaded rotunda, broad lead-grey dome and small lantern, strongroom to the south-east, busy street outside and a dark back alley along the outer wall. Warm low autumn sun from upper left.
svg.text: GD / AUCTION HOUSE / FORECOURT GATE STUDY
District 03 / high autumn morning / warm low sun from upper left, cool sky fill / palette.json tones only
back alley along the outer wall
Busy street outside, quiet walled close inside: the round-arched Forecourt Gate frames the only broad metal dome.

V4-style approach, eye 1.65 m / Ø28 m colonnaded drum, 30 m lead-grey dome, 34 m lantern / strongroom 12 × 10 × 9 m to the south-east with a narrow round-arched door / iron rails, paired lanterns, sealed crates.
Back alley behind the trade row runs along the outer wall: smoked oak, stained plaster, puddled setts, refuse, moss, no lanterns. Blank signs and diamond banners only; no gold, no Gothic forms.
CONCEPT / NOVEMBER 2026 • PROPOSED, NOT AN ENGINE CAPTURE • PERSPECTIVE COMPOSITION, NOT A MEASURED CAMERA • 180 cm figures / 100 × 210 cm doors
